log.action: Charge Dorian with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 1 | Day 1, 6:11 pmLongsword attackd20: 17 -- successLongsword damaged20: 8 -- successDorian Nighthollow attackd20: 10 -- failedSlaver raiders attackd20: 16 -- successSlaver raiders damaged20: 5 -- successYou crash through the ash with your longsword thrust before you, and Dorian barely twists aside before steel bites beneath his ribs. “Still charging like a kennel hound,” Dorian Nighthollow snarls, his hooked blade scraping your mail without finding flesh. A raider’s axe slams into your shoulder and jars your teeth, while the other slavers spread to pen you against the stricken wagon.🔊………

log.action: Take cover behind the merchant wagon.
log.narration: Turn 2 | Day 1, 6:12 pmSlaver raiders attackd20: 9 -- failedYou drop behind the wagon as an axe-head cleaves the rail above your skull and showers you with splinters. The mule kicks against its traces, wild-eyed and bleeding, while Dorian stalks around the far wheel with his hooked steel held low. A second raider circles wide through the ash, seeking the open side of your shelter.🔊………

log.action: Take cover behind the merchant wagon.
log.narration: Turn 3 | Day 1, 6:13 pmDorian Nighthollow attackd20: 7 -- failedSlaver raiders Stealth checkd20: 16 -- successYou press lower against the wagon’s broken flank, and the ash turns your sweat to gray paste. Dorian’s hooked blade probes beneath the axle, then withdraws when he sees no opening. “The master wants you breathing, Korrag,” Dorian Nighthollow says. “There is a collar waiting, and a pit that remembers your name.” One raider crawls beneath the wagon’s rear bed, close enough that you hear his mail scrape on stone.🔊………

log.action: Cut the mule free from its traces.
log.narration: Turn 4 | Day 1, 6:14 pmDexterity checkd20: 15 -- successSlaver raiders attackd20: 8 -- failedDorian Nighthollow attackd20: 18 -- successDorian Nighthollow damaged20: 6 -- successYou seize the leather harness and hack through it while the raider beneath the bed lunges for your ankle. The blade parts the last strap, and the mule bursts northward in blind terror, dragging a snapped shaft that batters the raider flat beneath the wagon. Dorian vaults the wheel with murder in his eyes, his hooked sword descending toward your head.🔊………

log.action: Stab beneath the wagon at the crawling raider.
log.narration: Turn 5 | Day 1, 6:15 pmLongsword attackd20: 16 -- successLongsword damaged20: 10 -- successYou drive your longsword beneath the wagon, following the scrape of mail through the ash. The crawling raider cries out once as your point finds the seam below his breastplate, then lies still amid the broken traces. Dorian’s shadow falls across the wagon rail, and his hooked steel glints above you.🔊………

log.action: Roll beneath the wagon's far side.
log.narration: Turn 6 | Day 1, 6:16 pmDexterity checkd20: 13 -- successDorian Nighthollow attackd20: 11 -- failedYou flatten yourself in the bitter dirt and roll under the wagon’s belly as Dorian’s hook tears a strip from the bed above. You rise on the far side with the wagon between you and him, but the wounded raider drags himself from the traces clutching his gut. Dorian circles through the haze, patient now, while his man blocks the north road with a notched axe.🔊………

log.action: Power Strike Dorian at close range.
log.narration: Turn 7 | Day 1, 6:17 pmLongsword attack with Power Striked20: 19 -- successLongsword damage with Power Striked20: 13 -- successYou spring from the wagon’s shadow and meet Dorian before his hook can gather force. Your longsword smashes through his guard, and the Power Strike drives steel deep beneath his collarbone. Dorian Nighthollow folds against the wheel with blood black on his teeth, while the last raider bellows and raises his axe alone.🔊………

log.action: Circle the wagon toward the east trail.
log.narration: Turn 8 | Day 1, 6:18 pmDexterity checkd20: 14 -- successSlaver raiders attackd20: 12 -- failedYou skirt the wagon’s shattered tongue and gain the eastern trail, where the ash lies smooth beneath your boots. The surviving raider lunges around the wheel, but his axe whistles past as you turn his flank. Behind him, Dorian’s corpse slumps in the dirt, and the road into the Blighted Reach yawns open like a grave.🔊………

log.action: Use the wagon wheel as cover.
log.narration: Turn 9 | Day 1, 6:19 pmSlaver raiders attackd20: 6 -- failedYou crouch behind the wheel as the raider’s axe bites the rim and sticks fast in the splintered wood. His weight hauls him forward for one naked instant, with the east trail at your back and Dorian’s blood darkening the ash. The slaver wrenches at the trapped haft, snarling through broken teeth.🔊………

log.action: Circle the wagon and draw the raider away.
log.narration: Turn 10 | Day 1, 6:20 pmDexterity checkd20: 16 -- successSlaver raiders attackd20: 14 -- failedYou break from the wheel and run the wagon’s length, keeping the carcass of timber between you and the axe. The raider takes the bait with a roar, chasing your footfalls through the powdery ground. When he rounds the front corner, he is stranded in the open, his weapon still fouled with wood splinters.🔊………

log.action: Retreat along the east trail.
log.narration: Turn 11 | Day 1, 6:21 pmStrength checkd20: 15 -- successSlaver raiders ranged attackd20: 9 -- failedYou back down the eastern trail with your blade leveled, then turn and run when the wagon vanishes behind a curtain of ash. The raider rips free of the wreck and hurls his axe after you, but it buries itself in the trailbank. His boots hammer after yours from the gray murk, close enough that flight has become a chase rather than escape.🔊………

log.action: Strike the raider while his axe is stuck.
log.narration: Turn 12 | Day 1, 6:22 pmLongsword attackd20: 18 -- successLongsword damaged20: 9 -- successYou wheel in the ash as the raider claws for the axe lodged in the trailbank. Your longsword takes him across the throat before his fingers close on the haft, and he falls face-first into the gray earth. Silence claims the fork behind you, broken only by the wounded wagon groaning in the wind.🔊………

log.action: Turn and charge the unarmed raider.
log.narration: Turn 13 | Day 1, 6:27 pmThe unarmed raider does not rise. Your charge ends above his corpse, where the ash has clogged the blood at his throat. Beneath his torn collar, a gilded brand shows a barred fighting cage above the mark of Ashenveil’s south gate, and you know that sign from the hidden pits where men were bought for pain. The trail beyond him runs east into a silence that feels watchful.🔊………

log.action: Search the raider's body.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 1, 6:57 pmYou turn the corpse with a boot and search its mail while cold ash worms beneath your sleeves. A hidden pocket yields a stoppered vial of black fluid, thick as pitch, and the glass sweats warmth against your palm. The dead man’s jaw is broken around a bite-mark, as though he died trying to swallow the thing before steel found him.🔊………

log.action: Examine the gilded brand closely.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 1, 6:57 pmYou turn the corpse with a boot and search its mail while cold ash worms beneath your sleeves. A hidden pocket yields a stoppered vial of black fluid, thick as pitch, and the glass sweats warmth against your palm. The dead man’s jaw is broken around a bite-mark, as though he died trying to swallow the thing before steel found him.🔊………

log.action: Return south toward Ashenveil.
log.narration: Turn 16 | Day 1, 8:57 pmThe South Road bears you through drifting ash until Ashenveil rises from the plain, its walls black and wet-looking beneath the cold sky. The High Gate stands open between iron towers, with the South Road behind you, the market streets beyond, and a narrow guard stair climbing each wall. An antlered hollow-born guard steps into your path, his spear angled at your chainmail and bloodied sword.  “That cage-mark is not a tavern token, Northlander. Tell me why you wear its dead men’s blood.”🔊………

log.action: Examine the gilded brand closely.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 1, 9:07 pmYou scrape ash from the dead slaver’s collar and study the stamp until its gold gleams through the grime. The cage-lines are not ink or common dye. They have been burned into flesh with a metal seal, and a faint bitter reek clings to them, like smoke from a burned shrine. Helvik Stonegall watches your hands with the fixed stare of a man measuring whether to call more spears.🔊………

log.action: Ask about the hidden fighting pits.
log.narration:
Turn 18 | Day 1, 9:27 pm“Where are the hidden fighting pits?”  Helvik Stonegall’s grip tightens on his spear until the leather creaks.  
“Ask that loudly and someone will put a knife in your back before dusk. The Low Quarter hears talk of gilded cages, but I have never seen a door that admits it.”  A bell clangs within the gatehouse. Two armored figures emerge from the market street, their visors shut and their eyes fixed on the brand.🔊………

log.action: Ask about the hidden fighting pits.
log.narration:
Turn 19 | Day 1, 9:37 pmHelvik’s mouth hardens.  
“I answered. Go south and listen where the lanterns burn blue, if you hunger for that answer.”  The two visored figures halt beneath the gate’s shadow. One bears a hooked cudgel, the other carries a chain wrapped about a gauntlet, and neither wears Ashenveil’s colors.  “The marked man comes with us.”🔊………

log.action: Slip into the market street.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 1, 9:42 pmStealth checkd20: 17 -- successYou slip past Helvik’s spear as the gate bell hammers above you, then vanish into a tide of market bodies and fish-stink. Durdun Lorrath curses behind you, and Thorvik Mordrath’s chain bites sparks from the paving stones as he gives chase. Ahead, blue lanterns sway over a narrow southern alley.🔊………

log.action: Draw my sword and strike the cudgel-bearer.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 1, 9:43 pmLongsword attackd20: 16 -- successLongsword damaged20: 10 -- successYou whirl beneath the blue lamps and cut at Durdun Lorrath before his hooked cudgel can rise. Steel parts the leather at his ribs, and he staggers into a stall of split eels with a roar that sends the vendors scattering. Thorvik Mordrath comes through the panic with his chain already singing overhead.🔊………

log.action: Hide among the market crowd.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 1, 9:44 pmStealth checkd20: 15 -- successThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 10 -- failedYou plunge through the screaming market throng and kick a basket of silver fish beneath Thorvik Mordrath’s boots. Bodies close around you, reeking of sweat and brine, while Durdun Lorrath claws blood from his side and bellows for your head. Thorvik’s chain snaps through a hanging cloth awning where you stood a heartbeat before.🔊………

log.action: Use Power Strike on Durdun.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 1, 9:45 pmLongsword attackd20: 17 -- successLongsword damage (Power Strike)d20: 9 -- successDurdun Lorrath attackd20: 8 -- failedThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 11 -- failedYou burst from the press of bodies and drive your shoulder into Durdun Lorrath’s wounded side. His cudgel dips. You bring the sword down with all the hard strength of the north behind it, splitting mail rings and carving a red seam across his chest. Durdun reels, but Thorvik’s chain whips toward your skull through the smoke.🔊………

log.action: Cut Thorvik while he stumbles over the fish.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 1, 9:46 pmLongsword attackd20: 19 -- successLongsword damaged20: 8 -- successDurdun Lorrath attackd20: 12 -- failedThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 9 -- failedThorvik’s heel skids on the spilled fish, and his iron chain slaps uselessly against a stallpost. You slash across his thigh, opening it to the bone through his dark trousers. He catches himself on one hand and rises with murder in his eyes, while Durdun presses a palm to the ruin of his chest and lunges through the crowd.🔊………

log.action: Shove Durdun into the eel stall.
log.narration: Turn 25 | Day 1, 9:47 pmStrength checkd20: 17 -- successThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 12 -- failedYou slam both hands into Durdun’s breastbone and drive him backward. He crashes through the eel stall in a burst of brine and splintered boards, his cudgel spinning from his grip beneath the fish. Thorvik lashes his chain at you, but the hook tears only cloth from your shoulder as you regain your footing.🔊………

log.action: Raise Shield Wall against Thorvik's chain.
log.narration: Turn 26 | Day 1, 9:48 pmThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 16 -- successThorvik Mordrath damaged20: 5 -- successYou set your boots among the eel-slime and turn your shoulder into the chain’s path. Thorvik’s hook smashes against your braced mail, bruising bone but failing to break you. Durdun gropes amid the shattered stall for his lost cudgel, blood running between his fingers.🔊………

log.action: Rush Thorvik before his chain rises.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 1, 9:49 pmLongsword attackd20: 15 -- successLongsword damaged20: 7 -- successThorvik Mordrath attackd20: 7 -- failedYou rush through the chain’s shrinking circle and hammer Thorvik Mordrath against a granite wall. Your sword punches beneath his ribs, but he snarls through clenched teeth and smashes his gauntlet into your face. Durdun drags his cudgel from the eel-strewn wreckage, rising on shaking legs.🔊………

log.action: Slash Thorvik's chain hand.
log.narration: Turn 28 | Day 1, 9:50 pmLongsword attackd20: 16 -- successLongsword damaged20: 8 -- successDurdun Lorrath attackd20: 14 -- successDurdun Lorrath damaged20: 6 -- successYour blade bites into Thorvik’s chain hand. Fingers burst open, and the iron links fall clattering across the stones as he staggers back with blood pouring from his ruined grip. Durdun comes up from the wrecked stall with his cudgel and swings low, smashing it into your ribs with all his failing weight.🔊………

log.action: Power Strike Thorvik against the granite wall.
log.narration: Turn 29 | Day 1, 9:55 pmYou lunge for Thorvik, but Durdun’s cudgel-blow has cracked something deep beneath your mail. Your sword-arm falters. The market stones rise beneath your cheek, hot with spilled blood, while Thorvik’s unbroken hand knots in your hair and Durdun hauls you toward the blue-lit alleys.🔊………

log.action: Grab Thorvik's fallen chain.
log.narration: Turn 30 | Day 1, 9:58 pmBlackness holds you fast. Thorvik’s chain lies beyond your slack hand, half-buried in fish scales, while the two slavers drag you through the crush of terrified bodies toward the blue lamps.🔊………

log.action: Feign unconsciousness as they drag me.
log.narration: Turn 31 | Day 1, 10:08 pmYou need not feign what the cudgel has made real. Your body hangs slack between Durdun and Thorvik as they bear you south through a curtain of blue lanternlight. Beneath one lamp, a narrow alley opens its throat between leaning warehouses, and a gilded cage sigil gleams on a door of black iron.🔊………

log.action: Force myself awake and struggle.
log.narration: Turn 32 | Day 1, 10:09 pmConstitution saving throwd20: 16 -- successStrength checkd20: 13 -- failedPain tears you from the black gulf. You wrench upright between your captors, and Thorvik’s mangled hand loses its grip in a spray of fresh blood. Durdun locks an arm around your throat and rams you against the iron door while the gilded seal begins to turn beneath his palm.🔊………

log.action: Twist free and roll into the alley.
log.narration: Turn 33 | Day 1, 10:11 pmYour legs fold before the twist can free you. Durdun drives you through the black iron door, where a horned tiefling in a butcher’s apron catches your weight and laughs through filed teeth. Behind him, torchlight reveals a stairwell descending into the roar of a hidden crowd.🔊………

log.action: Stomp Thorvik's wounded foot.
log.narration: Turn 34 | Day 1, 10:12 pmYour heel twitches, but the command dies in the red dark before it reaches your foot. Thorvik hears nothing but the roar below and spits blood onto the threshold. Kaelan Brackstone grips your collar with his hooked fingers and drags you toward the descending stair.🔊………

log.action: Headbutt Kaelan Brackstone.
log.narration: Turn 35 | Day 1, 10:13 pmYou heave your skull toward Kaelan Brackstone, but darkness clamps your muscles before the blow can rise. The tiefling laughs once and hurls you down the stairwell, where your body strikes the landing amid old blood and damp straw.🔊………

log.action: Brace against the stairwell wall.
log.narration: Turn 36 | Day 1, 10:14 pmYour palms scrape stone, but they cannot catch the wall. You strike the landing limp and slide through the straw. Kaelan Brackstone descends behind you with iron shackles in hand, while Durdun bars the door above and Thorvik limps after him, rage burning through his pain.🔊………

log.action: Crawl into the damp straw.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 1, 10:16 pmYour fingers claw at the littered floor, yet your strength gutters before you gain a handspan. Kaelan Brackstone rolls you onto your back and strips away your sword, then plucks the black vial from your gear with a butcher’s grin.  “The Shadow Alchemist’s draught, carried by a stray hound. That will buy you a longer death.”  Iron closes around your wrists. From beneath the stair comes a bestial roar, followed by the crash of a crowd hungry for blood.🔊………

log.action: Grab the iron shackles.
log.narration: Turn 38 | Day 1, 10:18 pmYour hand jerks toward the iron, then falls flat in the filthy straw. Kaelan cinches the manacles until metal bites your wrists and pulls a leather hood over your face. Below, the arena’s chant swells into a war-drum cadence as your captors haul you toward the pit.🔊………

log.action: Listen for sounds below.
log.narration: Turn 39 | Day 1, 10:20 pmThe hood turns sound into a muffled sea, yet the under-earth carries violence well. Many boots stamp in unison below, then a gate groans wide and something heavy snarls behind it. Kaelan’s grip tightens on your chain as he draws you onward.🔊………

log.action: Twist my wrists against the shackles.
log.narration: Turn 40 | Day 1, 10:22 pmThe shackles rasp together, but the command cannot reach hands drowned beneath blood loss. Kaelan Brackstone drags you down the last steps as the chanting changes to a single ravenous roar. Beyond the hood, a furnace breathes and iron gates slam shut.🔊………

log.action: Kick wildly toward Kaelan.
log.narration: Turn 41 | Day 1, 10:23 pmYour leg spasms beneath you, then drags uselessly across the stone. Kaelan Brackstone laughs through his teeth and jerks the chain hard enough to wrench your shoulders. The roar beyond the hood stops at once, leaving a silence that feels like a blade poised over flesh.🔊………

log.action: Test the chain for slack.
log.narration: Turn 42 | Day 1, 10:25 pmYour wrists give no answer. Kaelan Brackstone hauls your limp weight across the sand and fastens your fetters to a ring sunk beside the central pit. Somewhere beyond the galleries, a beast hammers its body against a barred gate.🔊………

log.action: Bellow a challenge into the silence.
log.narration: Turn 43 | Day 1, 10:26 pmNo challenge leaves your throat. Blood loss has made your body a wrecked fortress, and only a ragged breath stirs beneath the hood. Kaelan Brackstone gives the chain a contemptuous kick, then the barred gate to your left crashes upward and a thick-bodied shape pads across the sand.  “Wake when it tears you, Northman.”🔊………

log.action: Call out to Kaelan Brackstone.
log.narration: Turn 44 | Day 1, 10:27 pmYour lungs scrape for a shout, but the hood drinks the sound before it is born. The shape in the sand answers with a wet snarl, and its claws score furrows toward your chained body. Kaelan Brackstone steps beyond its reach and watches.🔊………

log.action: Wrench the chain against the iron ring.
log.narration: Turn 45 | Day 1, 10:28 pmThe chain holds fast, and your strength is still buried beneath the black tide of pain. The pit hound launches from the sand with drool swinging from its jaws. Its teeth close on your shoulder, and agony rips the hooded dark apart.🔊………

log.action: Snarl at Kaelan Brackstone.
log.narration: Turn 46 | Day 1, 10:29 pmPit hound attackd20: 9 -- missA raw snarl tears from your throat, and Kaelan Brackstone’s grin hardens.  “There you are. Die loud, then.”  The pit hound snaps for your face, but your rolling shoulder makes its teeth shear through the hood instead.🔊………

log.action: Use Power Strike with a heel kick.
log.narration: Turn 47 | Day 1, 10:30 pmStrength attackd20: 21 -- successPit hound attackd20: 11 -- missYou wrench one knee high and drive your heel into the hound’s muzzle with all the savagery left in you. Bone cracks beneath the blow, and the beast staggers sideways, spraying black saliva across the sand. It lunges again, but its teeth smash against your chainmail and skid away.🔊………

log.action: Yank the chain toward Kaelan Brackstone.
log.narration: Turn 48 | Day 1, 10:31 pmIntimidation checkd20: 15 -- successPit hound attackd20: 6 -- missYou heave the chain toward Kaelan Brackstone, but the floor-ring holds and only rattles sand. The tiefling remains beyond the length of it, while the pit hound circles with blood pouring from its broken snout. It springs for your throat, then balks as your glare meets its yellow eyes.🔊………

log.action: Roll beneath the pit hound’s leap.
log.narration: Turn 49 | Day 1, 10:32 pmDexterity checkd20: 14 -- successPit hound attackd20: 7 -- missYou throw your weight sideways as the beast descends, and its claws rake only the sand where your throat had lain. The chain savages your wrists, yet it gives you just enough room to leave the hound sprawled beyond your boots. Kaelan Brackstone’s laughter dies when the animal rises shaking and uncertain.🔊………

log.action: Twist my wrists against the shackles.
log.narration: Turn 50 | Day 1, 10:33 pmStrength checkd20: 22 -- successPit hound attackd20: 8 -- missYou brace your heels in the grit and wrench until the iron ring tears loose from its crumbling socket. The hound snaps at your ribs, but the ripped hood tangles across its eyes and its jaws close on empty air. Kaelan Brackstone recoils from the pit’s edge as you rise with a length of chain hanging from your wrists.🔊………
